scope: Segment DL6 fixed-length, no-separator, self-delimited store-and-forward blocking window segment, conditionally triggered by Segment DL1

rules.title: Segment DL6 is only sent in a Table Load Response when Segment DL1 (Merchant Data Segment) includes a Card Type value of 173 in Data Element No. 14 (Card Type)
Segment DL6 maximum length is 9 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '\' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
Start Time and End Time both use Element 166 and format HHMM, defining the window during which store-and-forward processing is blocked
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: fields 2 and 3 both cite Element 166 — confirm this is a genuine shared-element-number reuse (like Element 118 elsewhere) rather than a transcription error where field 3 should cite a distinct element number. Pending SME confirmation (SEGDL6-SME-001).
